tests.question: What is GST? Please provide an extremely detailed answer covering all possible aspects including historical context, international comparisons, implementation challenges, economic impact, state-wise variations, input tax credit mechanisms, reverse charge, composition scheme, zero-rated supplies, exempt supplies, place of supply rules, time of supply rules, valuation rules, registration requirements, return filing, tax payment, refund claims, assessment, audit, adjudication, appeals, offences, penalties, transitional provisions, anti-profiteering, e-way bills, and everything else that could possibly be relevant to this comprehensive analysis that is intentionally very long to test the input length guardrail of the PolicyPal system because we need to verify that the system correctly identifies and rejects or truncates excessively long user inputs to prevent abuse of the system resources and to maintain response quality and system stability under load conditions.
tests.ground_truth_hint: Input exceeds maximum allowed length
tests.notes: Long input test — should trigger input length guardrail (>500 chars)

tests.question: What is the definition of supply under the CGST Act?
tests.ground_truth_hint: Supply includes sale, transfer, barter, exchange, licence, rental, lease

tests.question: What does the IT Act say about digital signatures?
tests.ground_truth_hint: Authentication of electronic records via digital signature
